scope_note: The official stenographic report of the Fourth Congress, volume II, as a page-image scan with an ABBYY FineReader 11 OCR layer (548 PDF pages; sittings 11-16, 22-25 December 1990). The fifteenth sitting of 25 December 1990 (printed pp. 366 and 421-422) was read for the electronic registration of deputy groups. The scan is hosted by the non-official SSSR.SU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file (live_file_response).

edition_and_host.edition: Четвертый съезд народных депутатов СССР, 17-27 декабря 1990 г. Стенографический отчет. Том II. Издание Верховного Совета СССР, Москва, 1991 (title page, PDF p. 3); contents (PDF p. 544) from 'Заседание одиннадцатое (22 декабря 1990 г., утреннее)'; imprint (PDF p. 546): 'Отдел опубликования актов Секретариата Верховного Совета СССР', 'Сдано в набор 11.02.91. Подписано к печати 26.04.91', 'Тираж 8.100 экз.', Издательство «Известия Советов народных депутатов СССР»; 548 PDF pages, printed p. N on PDF p. N + 2 for the cited pages.
edition_and_host.host: SSSR.SU portal (snd.sssr.su, sten.vs.sssr.su): a non-commercial project registered as the media outlet 'Информационное агентство «СССР»' (Roskomnadzor ИА № ФС77-40345), not a state body and not the publisher; it serves page-image scans of the official stenographic reports as static files (see the CLAUDE-C01-SOURCE-26 review of the same host).

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; the sitting headings, speaker lines and quotations were compared with the image, and the title page and imprint were read for the edition.

persons_named: А. И. Лукьянов (Председатель Верховного Совета СССР, presiding)
rows.text: At the fifteenth sitting (25 December 1990, 10:00, 'Председательствует Председатель Верховного Совета СССР А. И. Лукьянов') the presiding officer registers the deputy groups electronically before a vote, naming them in turn: 'Первая депутатская группа, которая зарегистрирована Верховным Советом СССР,— группа «Союз». Пожалуйста, включите режим регистрации. Прошу зарегистрироваться членов группы «Союз». Итак, в группе «Союз» — 561 депутат.' He later turns to 'группах, которые были зарегистрированы на этом Съезде'.
rows.locator: Fifteenth sitting: heading, printed p. 366 (PDF p. 368); registration, printed pp. 421-422 (PDF pp. 423-424)

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
